hypotheses.title: Quarterly Estimate Upgrade Acceleration, Forward Cash Flow Yield & Bounded Options VRP
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Alpha 10 locked in 1-year annual EPS yield (252-day lookback) with Sharpe 1.96. To break self-correlation below 0.70 while preserving elite Sharpe >= 1.80, Candidate 1 contracts the lookback window to 90 days, capturing high-velocity quarterly earnings announcement upgrades. Concurrently, Candidate 2 harnesses sell-side consensus forward Cash Flow Per Share yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean), exploiting pure operational cash generation stripped of accrual accounting adjustments. Candidate 3 captures the structural Variance Risk Premium (VRP) by taking the 1-year time-series rank of 30-day realized volatility over implied volatility (historical_volatility_30 / (implied_volatility_mean_30 + 0.001)), providing bounded dimensionless normalization to prevent weight concentration spikes while securing zero correlation (< 0.15) to fundamental forecast models.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if quarterly estimate revisions mean-revert too rapidly without price drift or if normalized options variance risk premium loses predictive power across liquid large-cap equities.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: 90-Day Quarterly Forward EPS Upgrade Acceleration to break Alpha 10 self-correlation (<0.70) while maintaining Sharpe >= 1.85 and Fitness >= 1.50 in TOP1000
Candidate 2: 1-Year Consensus Forward Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP1000 targeting EXCELLENT rating (Sharpe >= 1.90, Fitness >= 1.55) and self-correlation < 0.50 against Alpha 10
Candidate 3: Bounded Options Variance Risk Premium (VRP) Ratio in TOP1000 to eliminate weight concentration and deliver uncorrelated (<0.15) Sharpe >= 1.50 and Fitness >= 1.40
